why: Current C++ CLI has ruled out simple Sharp Tail, final crop offset, output truncation, pad size, rotate float math, invalid input-rotate preservation, and simple B/denom initialization as the leading residual.
The Windows AEX scales Front/Back Blur Strength and Alpha Fade by a render-context ratio loaded from ctx+0x11c / ctx+0x120 before truncating to int.
Existing manifests do not record those render-context fields, and the current CLI uses 1/frame_rate only as a PNG-fit diagnostic.
The current references are fully opaque for the tracked front-only cases, so source RGB premultiplication and alpha side-channel behavior are not discriminating.
instrumentation_requirements: If possible, log the two render-context integers read by OLMDirectionalBlur.aex at ctx+0x11c and ctx+0x120, plus their float ratio, for each render.
If direct ctx logging is not practical from AE scripting, record every available render/downsample/resolution/quality field that may correspond to those context integers.
Record comp frame_rate separately, but do not use it as the render-context scale label unless ctx+0x11c/0x120 proves that mapping.
Record project_gpu_accel_type.current_name and raw value per render set.
Keep ADBE Force CPU GPU / GPU Rendering as reference-only metadata, not as the execution-path label.

inputs.description: Current OLM test cell/line-art source, fully opaque. This should reproduce current case_0001 and case_0005 behavior.
Transparent background with several fully opaque colored shapes and hard alpha edges.
Colored source with horizontal and vertical alpha ramps including 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1.0 alpha regions.

cases.reason: Re-render current case_0001 under SOFTWARE while recording render-context scale fields.
Re-render current case_0005 under SOFTWARE while recording render-context scale fields.
Isolate row scatter and strength scale without Sharp Tail or Size Variation.
Make strength-scale inference easier with a small, visible span.
Discriminate FUN_180001000 alpha_or_valid and source RGB premultiplication behavior.
Exercise rotate helper, alpha-weighted bilinear sampling, alpha_or_valid, and row scatter on non-opaque data.
Check component area coefficient and Size Variation once alpha side-channel is discriminating.
Re-check component Sharp Tail with non-opaque alpha after opaque refs made tail probes nearly neutral.

variant_matrix.reason: Detect whether ctx+0x11c/0x120 maps to frame duration/rate or another render scale.
If easy to automate, detect whether ctx+0x11c/0x120 tracks downsample/resolution factor.

manifest_requirements: Record all OLM DirectionalBlur property names, match_names, property_index, value, and enabled/active state.
Record project_gpu_accel_type.current_name and raw value per render set.
Record comp width, height, pixel aspect, bpc, frame_rate, and resolution/downsample settings.
Record ctx+0x11c, ctx+0x120, and ctx_render_scale = float(ctx+0x11c) / float(ctx+0x120) if instrumentation can access them.
Keep ADBE Force CPU GPU / GPU Rendering as reference-only metadata, not as the execution-path label.
mac_side_followup: Run existing OLMDirectionalBlur full-choreo and prepass CLI probes against the new cases.
Replace --strength-scale auto with ctx_render_scale when manifest provides it.
Use alpha_hard_edges / alpha_ramp cases to decide source RGB premultiplication and alpha_or_valid semantics.
